end.line: Quillon for Pelham Grant’s litigation team

vo: Pelham Grant’s twenty-two litigators run disclosure reviews of up to two hundred thousand documents.
Quillon builds the witness chronology from the exhibits, and every event links back to its source document.
Ask a first-pass merits question, and the answer comes back cited to the exact page.
Your positions are kept in the playbook, learned from closed matters and reviewed by a partner.
Priya will walk your team through it on Tuesday the eighteenth.
